seed_values.the call: DusB-like FMN-dependent tRNA-dihydrouridine synthase catalyzing reduction of uridine residues in tRNA to dihydrouridine.
seed_values.eggNOG: Catalyzes the synthesis of 5,6-dihydrouridine (D), a modified base found in the D-loop of most tRNAs, via the reduction of the C5-C6 double bond in target uridines
